long_biography.plain_text:
Kaulig Racing grew from a single-car venture into a team competing in NASCAR’s top series under owner Matt Kaulig. A former University of Akron quarterback, he has invested in the Cleveland Guardians baseball club and supported youth-focused charities in northeast Ohio.

The foundation was LeafFilter, a gutter-protection company he started in his Ohio home with an installer and a marketer after selling home-improvement products for other firms. As it expanded into residential services, investment firm Gridiron Capital became a partner and later the majority owner of the combined Leaf Home business. Kaulig now directs his own investment office alongside Tim Clepper, with holdings spanning consumer products, private investments, media and sport.
long_biography.html:
Kaulig Racing grew from a single-car venture into a team competing in NASCAR’s top series under owner Matt Kaulig. A former University of Akron quarterback, he has invested in the Cleveland Guardians baseball club and supported youth-focused charities in northeast Ohio.

The foundation was LeafFilter, a gutter-protection company he started in his Ohio home with an installer and a marketer after selling home-improvement products for other firms. As it expanded into residential services, investment firm Gridiron Capital became a partner and later the majority owner of the combined Leaf Home business. Kaulig now directs his own investment office alongside Tim Clepper, with holdings spanning consumer products, private investments, media and sport.
